short: Atta — the engine for the Den: resolve, route, render
is: Atta, the host-agnostic engine for the Den: it resolves the tree, enforces its structural rules, routes each operation to the handler registered for a node type, and renders files. Types and content are opaque to it; the host plugs in storage, standing and types through traits Atta defines. It lives in this workspace as a crate only until it is split into its own library.
conventions: Never depends on another workspace crate and never names a Zurfur type — host-agnostic by construction, so it can be split out unchanged.
Its role is fixed: resolve, enforce structure, route changes, render. How it does that grows only as real needs appear, never ahead of them.
Nothing reads a node except through Atta; a node is served only after its payload hash verifies.
